mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_favorite (user_id, session_id, question, answer, provider, model) VALUES (#{userId}, #{sessionId}, #{question}, #{answer}, #{provider}, #{model})
mapper.select:
SELECT f.id, f.user_id, f.session_id, f.question, f.answer, f.provider, f.model, f.created_at FROM chat_favorite f WHERE f.user_id = #{userId}
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chat_favorite_tag ft WHERE ft.favorite_id = f.id AND ft.tag_id = #{tagId})
AND (f.question LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR f.answer LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY f.id DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM chat_favorite WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
